message.content: {"mode": "sort", "events": ["D20:22-1:John:Yeah, I've read that other popular fantasy series too! It's one of my favorites. It has such a cool story!", "D22:12-3:John:I'm reading \"Dune\" by Frank Herbert. It's a great story about religion and human control over ecology. What about you? What's the last book that moved you?", "D19:20-1:John:I recently finished rereading \"The Alchemist\" - it was really inspiring. It made me think again about following dreams and searching for our own personal legends. I felt really motivated and hopeful after reading it.", "D11:27-1:John:Yep, I read that book and loved it! It made me think about life and how important it is to follow one's dreams. Highly recommend it!", "D27:22-3:John:I'm a huge fan of Lord of the Rings! The adventure, the world, and the characters are awesome. and shared a photo of a shelf with a lot of books on it", "D20:20-1:John:That bookshelf is awesome! The Hobbit is one of my favorites too. What an amazing journey!", "D19:16-2:John:I love non-fiction books about personal development and mindset. They help me know myself better. Do you enjoy reading other types of books as well?", "D4:10-1:John:I've been reading this inspiring book, it reminds me to keep dreaming.", "D14:23-1:John:I haven't had much time to read, but after we talked I finally picked up a book and it's been awesome! Talk to you later!", "D22:10-2:John:Thanks! I'm currently reading a book that I really enjoy. I highly recommend it!", "D5:14-1:John:Books can be so captivating, taking us on such incredible journeys! What's the name of it?", "D11:25-1:John:Thanks! I'll definitely check it out - looks like a great book to read while traveling. Can't wait to dive into it! Here's a photo of my bookshelf. You can see some of the books I've read and enjoyed. and shared a photo of a bookshelf with a lot of books on it", "D27:4-3:John:Italy was awesome! Everything from the food to the history and architecture was amazing. I even got this awesome book while I was there and it's been giving me some cooking inspiration.", "D20:26-1:John:Yeah, it's awesome! Like being transported to a different world with all those amazing moments - so fun! and shared a photo of a forest with sun shining through the trees", "D19:22-3:John:Yeah, that book is really something. It really helped motivate me to keep chasing my dreams and to trust the process. It's amazing how books can have such an impact on us, right?", "D5:16-1:John:Sounds cool! I'll definitely check it out. Thanks for the recommendation!", "D22:16-1:John:No, I haven't read them yet but I'll definitely check them out. Cheers!", "D20:24-1:John:It's like escaping to these incredible new worlds and having a break from reality for a fun adventure.", "D4:8-5:John:Oh yeah, I remember you telling me about Harry Potter! I've got a funny story. Anthony and I went to this charity thing and ended up in this intense Harry Potter trivia contest. We did alright, but there was this one super-nerd there that took home this as a prize. and shared a photo of a book with a picture of a person holding a bookmark", "D19:14-1:John:Fantasy books always fuel my creativity, both in and outside of my hobbies. Are Harry Potter and GoT still your favorites?"]}
